commentaries.author: parimēlaḻagar
commentaries.text: Among all a man can gain, we value no gain but sons fit to know what should be known. “With understanding” shows that the word for children here leaves out daughters. The past tense is used because a fit nature is sure to bring knowledge. This tells the excellence of having sons.
